categories.name: Safety Breakaway Couplings
categories.shortDescription: Safety breakaway couplings: the weakest link in a hose line or loading arm, separating under excess pull with valves closing in both halves. Breaking-bolt and cable-release types, DN 25 to DN 300.
categories.seoTitle: Safety Breakaway Couplings — Breaking-Bolt & Cable Release
categories.seoDescription: Safety breakaway couplings for tanker loading, terminals and ship-to-shore transfer: MannTek SBC breaking-bolt (industrial or marine) and SBC-C cable release, DN 25 to DN 300.

hero.intro: A safety breakaway coupling protects a transfer line against drive-aways and pull-aways. Installed as the weakest link, it separates before the hose, loading arm or manifold is damaged, and the valves in both halves close as it parts, so only the volume between them is lost. Choose by how the line is installed and what its piping can take.

guidance.heading: Breaking bolt or cable release, industrial or marine
guidance.body: Breaking-bolt couplings release when the pull on the line reaches a set force. The industrial version releases at any angle from 0 to 90° and is fixed to one point, such as a truck or loading arm. The marine version releases only on straight pull and sits between two hose strings, as in ship-to-shore transfer. Cable-release couplings separate when a cable is pulled, and suit lines at high pressure on piping too weak to take the force that breaks bolts. In every case the breaking load is set for the installation: send us the hose size and length, pressure, medium and layout.

items.q: Where should a breakaway coupling be installed?
items.a: Where a vehicle, vessel or arm can move away while still connected: at the tank truck, on the loading arm, or between two hose strings in marine transfer. Industrial types need at least one fixed point; marine types sit between hoses.

items.q: Does a breakaway coupling stop all spillage?
items.a: Both halves close their valves as they separate, so the loss is limited to the small volume between the valves.

items.q: Can it be reused after it releases?
items.a: A MannTek SBC can be reset in minutes without special tools, with new breaking bolts, once the cause of the release is cleared.

products.title: MannTek DDC Dry Disconnect Coupling, Tank Unit — 1" to 8"
products.descriptionShort: MannTek DDC tank unit: the fixed half of a dry disconnect coupling for tankers, ISO and IBC containers, storage tanks and ship manifolds. 1" to 8", STANAG 3756 / ASTM F1122 interface, valve closes on disconnect with minimal product loss. From Indus Hydraulics, authorised MannTek distributor, UAE.
products.descriptionLong:
The tank unit is the fixed half of a MannTek Dry Disconnect Coupling (DDC). It has no swivel and is mounted permanently as the filling or discharge connector on storage tanks, IBC and ISO containers, road tankers, rail tank containers and ship manifolds. A DDC hose unit couples to it with a turning motion that opens the valves in both halves; turning back closes both valves before the halves separate, so the line disconnects with minimal product loss.

MannTek has built the DDC since 1995. The connection interface follows STANAG 3756 and ASTM F1122, the bayonet principle used across the fuel, chemical and petrochemical industries, so tank units and hose units of the same size are interchangeable.

Sizes and connections

Seven sizes from 1" (socket Ø 56 mm) to 8" (Ø 272 mm). The tank-side connection is a BSP or NPT thread, or a flange to ANSI, EN, TW, TTMA or JIS, with other flanges on request. MannTek publishes flow capacity from 380 L/min at 1" to 20,000 L/min at 8". The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists socket, threads, flanges and body materials for each size.

Materials and seals

  • Body: aluminium, brass or gun metal, stainless steel, titanium, Hastelloy, PVDF or PEEK, depending on size
  • Seals: FKM, NBR, EPDM or FFKM
  • Working pressure: 10 to 25 bar depending on body material, with a five times safety factor (MannTek)

Where it is used

Road and rail tanker loading and unloading, including bottom loading; ISO and IBC containers; industrial process plant; pharmaceutical and petrochemical transfer; and, in the 4" to 8" sizes, ship-to-shore, ship-to-ship and marine bunkering connections.

Options

  • Selectivity (coding) system: slots on the tank unit and pins on the hose unit stop the wrong medium being connected.
  • Stop before disconnect: detects a leaking valve before the halves can be separated.
  • Pressure equalizing valve and pressure bleeding valve for trapped or rising line pressure.
  • Hose unit with electronic sensor reporting valve open or closed, for interlocks and drive-away protection.
  • Drain connection, open/close indicator, colour coding, special handles, and compact, angular or eccentric-flange tank units.

Indus Hydraulics is an authorised MannTek distributor in the UAE and supplies MannTek couplings direct from MannTek in Sweden.

How to order

Send the size, the body material, the connection you need (thread type and size, or flange standard and rating), the seal material and the medium, and list any options. We confirm the MannTek order code, price and lead time with the quotation.

faqs.question: What is the difference between a tank unit and a hose unit?
faqs.answer: The tank unit is the fixed half, with no swivel, mounted on the tank, container or manifold. The hose unit is the moving half, with a swivel and handles, fitted to the hose or loading arm. Both contain a valve, and both valves close before the halves separate.

faqs.question: Will a MannTek DDC connect to another maker's dry disconnect coupling?
faqs.answer: The DDC connection interface follows STANAG 3756 and ASTM F1122, so a tank unit and hose unit of the same size built to that interface connect to each other. Send us the make and size fitted on site and we will confirm compatibility before you order.

faqs.question: Which body material should I choose?
faqs.answer: It depends on the medium. MannTek builds DDC bodies in aluminium, brass or gun metal, stainless steel, titanium, Hastelloy, PVDF and PEEK, with FKM, NBR, EPDM or FFKM seals. Tell us the fluid, its temperature and the operating pressure and we will propose a combination.

faqs.question: What pressure is a DDC rated for?
faqs.answer: MannTek publishes 10 to 25 bar working pressure for the DDC range, with a five times safety factor; the rating depends on the body material and size. The rating for your build is confirmed with the quotation.

faqs.question: Can the tank unit be fitted directly to a ball valve?
faqs.answer: Yes. MannTek offers a tank unit with non-projecting pistons for direct mounting on ball valves, plus compact, angular and eccentric-flange tank units where space or drainage requires it. Tell us the installation.

products.title: MannTek DDC Dust Caps, Dust Plugs and Pressure Caps — 1" to 8"
products.descriptionShort: Closures for MannTek DDC dry disconnect couplings, 1" to 8": dust caps and dust plugs in PE, aluminium or stainless steel, sealing caps to 10 bar, and pressure caps with relief valve as third closure to ADR/RID. From Indus Hydraulics, authorised MannTek distributor, UAE.
products.descriptionLong:
A dry disconnect coupling left open collects dirt, water and grit on its sealing faces, and that is what wears valves and seals. MannTek makes closures for every DDC size so each half can be capped when it is not in use, and, on road and rail tankers, so the tank unit can carry the pressure-rated third closure the dangerous-goods rules ask for.

The four types

  • Dust caps in PE (polyethylene composite), aluminium or stainless steel. A spring-loaded locking pin has to be pulled before the cap comes off, so it cannot be released by accident. Simple rubber, AdBlue and plastic caps are listed for some sizes.
  • Dust plugs in PE, aluminium or stainless steel, supplied with cable attachment and eyelets. MannTek recommends them to extend the life of the coupler.
  • Sealing caps in aluminium or stainless steel, pressure-tight to 10 bar, for duties that need a tight closure but no pressure relief.
  • Pressure caps with a pressure relief valve: stainless steel PN 25, aluminium PN 10 for road tankers, and an aluminium pressure cap at 4". MannTek describes them as a third closure to ADR/RID 6.8.2.2.2.

Which closures each size takes

The range differs by size: the 2" coupling has the widest choice, and 6" and 8" have dust caps and plugs only. The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists every closure MannTek offers for each size, with its type and material.

Related options

MannTek also offers a vented dust and de-icing cap, a dust plug with purge capability and a safety pressure cap with warning indicators for excessive pressure. Ask if your installation needs one of these.

Indus Hydraulics is an authorised MannTek distributor in the UAE and supplies MannTek couplings direct from MannTek in Sweden.

How to order

Send the size, the coupling half it closes, and the type and material from the size table. We confirm the MannTek order code, price and lead time with the quotation.

faqs.question: What is the difference between a sealing cap and a pressure cap?
faqs.answer: A sealing cap is pressure-tight to 10 bar but has no pressure relief. A pressure cap has a relief valve, so pressure that builds up behind it can be released safely; MannTek supplies it as the third closure on tankers under ADR/RID 6.8.2.2.2.

faqs.question: Do the caps fit other makers' dry disconnect couplings?
faqs.answer: They are made for the MannTek DDC interface, which follows STANAG 3756. Send us the make and size of the coupling on site and we will confirm the fit before you order.

faqs.question: Which material should I choose?
faqs.answer: PE is light and suits general use. Aluminium and stainless steel suit heavier service and can match the coupling body; choose stainless steel for corrosive media. Tell us the medium if you are unsure.

faqs.question: Why does the dust cap have a locking pin?
faqs.answer: The spring-loaded pin must be pulled before the cap can be removed, so the cap cannot come loose in transit or be knocked off.

faqs.question: Is there a cap for 6" and 8" couplings?
faqs.answer: Yes. MannTek lists dust caps in PE, aluminium and stainless steel and dust plugs for both sizes. Sealing and pressure caps are listed only up to 4".

products.focusKeyword: lpg dry gas coupling hose unit
products.descriptionShort: MannTek DGC hose unit: dry break coupling for LPG and other gases, the moving half with swivel for hose and loading arms; 2" and 3" in Design 2.0. 1" to 8", stainless steel, 25 bar, EN 13175. From Indus Hydraulics, authorised MannTek distributor, UAE.
products.descriptionLong:
The hose unit is the moving half of a MannTek Dry Gas Coupling (DGC), with an integrated swivel and handles. It is fitted to LPG hose assemblies and loading arms for temporary connection to a DGC tank unit. Turning the handles couples the halves and opens both valves in one motion; turning back closes them before the coupling separates.

Design 2.0

The 2" and 3" hose units are MannTek's Design 2.0 generation. MannTek reports up to 45% more flow capacity and up to 40% lower coupling force than the original design, with clear alignment indicators and a more compact handle rotation.

MannTek designed the DGC for liquefied petroleum gas (propane and butane); it is now used for many other gases. It is designed and manufactured to international standards such as EN 13175, and the 1" size serves as a heavy-duty vehicle adapter to EN 13760.

Sizes and connections

Six sizes from 1" (socket Ø 56 mm) to 8" (Ø 272 mm). Threaded connections are BSP, NPT or ACME, with Whitworth available, and flanges are to ANSI or EN. MannTek publishes flow capacity from 460 L/min at 1" to 24,200 L/min at 8". The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists each size and its typical duty.

Construction

  • Body: stainless steel
  • Seals: MannTek low-temperature FKM, for all LPG qualities and operating temperatures
  • Working pressure: 25 bar (MannTek)
  • Rubber protecting ring, weather-resistant and electrically non-conductive; inner cam curve protected from impact

Options

  • Locking device, stop before disconnect and electronic valve-position sensor
  • Hose unit with integrated safety breakaway
  • Pressure equalizing and pressure bleeding valves; drain connection to release trapped liquid
  • ACME and Whitworth threads for direct fitting to existing connections; colour coding

Indus Hydraulics is an authorised MannTek distributor in the UAE and supplies MannTek couplings direct from MannTek in Sweden.

How to order

Send the size, the body material, the connection you need (thread type and size, or flange standard and rating), the seal material and the medium, and list any options. We confirm the MannTek order code, price and lead time with the quotation.

products.title: MannTek SBC Safety Breakaway Coupling, Breaking-Bolt Type — DN 25 to DN 300
products.descriptionShort: MannTek SBC safety breakaway coupling with breaking bolts: the weakest link in a hose line or loading arm, separating under excess pull with both valves closed. Industrial or marine version, DN 25 to DN 300. From Indus Hydraulics, authorised MannTek distributor, UAE.
products.descriptionLong:
A safety breakaway coupling stops a drive-away or pull-away at a terminal from tearing the hose or loading arm off its connection. The MannTek SBC is installed in the transfer line as its weakest link: it is held together by breaking bolts, and when the pull on the line reaches a defined force the bolts break, the coupling separates and the valves in both halves close at once. The spill is limited to what sits between the valves, and the line and the equipment at each end are protected.

Industrial or marine version

  • Industrial: releases at any pull angle from 0 to 90°. Install it to at least one fixed point, for example at the tank truck or on the loading arm.
  • Marine: releases on straight (axial) pull only and will not release under an angular pull. Install it between two strings of hose, as in ship-to-shore and ship-to-ship transfer.

Breaking load

MannTek calculates the breaking load for each installation, so the coupling separates before the hose, arm or manifold is overloaded, and withstands extreme side load without releasing early. After activation the unit can be reset in minutes without special tools.

Sizes and connections

DN 25 (1") to DN 300 (12"). Inlet and outlet connections are chosen individually, in any combination: female or male BSP or NPT thread up to 8", flanges to EN, ANSI, TW or TTMA, Victaulic, or an integrated hose shank, so no nipples or reducers are needed. MannTek publishes flow capacity from 380 L/min at DN 25 to 44,500 L/min at DN 300.

Construction

  • Body: stainless steel 1.4408 (AISI 316) as standard; aluminium, brass or gun metal and Hastelloy / PVDF in smaller sizes; stainless steel only at 10" and 12"
  • Seals: FKM, NBR, EPDM or FFKM; low-temperature FKM for all LPG qualities
  • Working pressure: 25 bar, varying with body material (MannTek)
  • Poppet valve design, which avoids damaged valve seats and over-rotating flaps

Indus Hydraulics is an authorised MannTek distributor in the UAE and supplies MannTek couplings direct from MannTek in Sweden.

How to order

Send the size, the body material, the connection you need (thread type and size, or flange standard and rating), the seal material and the medium, and tell us the version (industrial or marine) and how the line is installed, so MannTek can calculate the breaking load. We confirm the MannTek order code, price and lead time with the quotation.

faqs.question: Industrial or marine version: which do I need?
faqs.answer: Use the industrial version where the coupling is fixed to one point, such as a truck or loading arm, and may be pulled at any angle; it releases from 0 to 90°. Use the marine version between two hose strings, as in ship-to-shore transfer; it releases only on straight pull.

faqs.question: How is the breaking load set?
faqs.answer: MannTek calculates it for each installation from the line and the equipment it protects. Send us the hose size and length, the operating pressure, the medium and how the line is fixed.

faqs.question: What happens after it releases?
faqs.answer: Both halves close their valves as they separate. Once the cause is cleared the unit can be reset in minutes without special tools, with new breaking bolts.

faqs.question: Does it need adapters to fit my hose or flange?
faqs.answer: Usually not. Inlet and outlet are specified separately, in thread, flange, Victaulic or hose-shank form, so the coupling fits the line directly.

faqs.question: Is there a version without breaking bolts?
faqs.answer: Yes. The SBC-C cable-release type separates when a release cable is pulled and suits lines with high operating pressure and a weak piping structure. It is listed separately.

products.title: MannTek SBC-C Cable-Release Safety Breakaway Coupling — DN 50 to DN 150
products.descriptionShort: MannTek SBC-C safety breakaway coupling released by cable rather than breaking bolts, for transfer lines with high operating pressure and a weak piping structure. Both valves close on release. DN 50 to DN 150. From Indus Hydraulics, authorised MannTek distributor, UAE.
products.descriptionLong:
The SBC-C is MannTek's cable-release safety breakaway coupling. Like the breaking-bolt SBC it protects hose assemblies against excessive load, but it separates when its release cable is pulled instead of when bolts break under line tension. MannTek recommends it for transfer systems that combine a high operating pressure with a weak piping structure, where the pull needed to break bolts would load the pipework more than it can take.

How it works

The coupling consists of two halves, each with its own valve. In service the valves are held open. When the cable pulls the release, the coupling separates and both valves close immediately, so the line is shut off at both ends of the break.

Sizes and construction

  • Sizes listed: DN 50, DN 63, DN 80, DN 100 and DN 150
  • Body: stainless steel 1.4408 (AISI 316) as standard, or aluminium
  • Inlet and outlet connections chosen individually: thread, flange or hose shank
  • Seals and working pressure confirmed for the medium and line with the quotation

Choosing between SBC and SBC-C

Choose the breaking-bolt SBC where the line and its supports can carry the release force, and the SBC-C where they cannot, or where the release must be triggered from a fixed point by cable. Send us the line pressure, size and layout and we will propose the type.

Indus Hydraulics is an authorised MannTek distributor in the UAE and supplies MannTek couplings direct from MannTek in Sweden.

How to order

Send the size, the body material, the connection you need (thread type and size, or flange standard and rating), the seal material and the medium, and describe where the release cable will be anchored. We confirm the MannTek order code, price and lead time with the quotation.

faqs.question: When is a cable-release breakaway better than breaking bolts?
faqs.answer: When the line runs at high pressure on piping that cannot take the pull needed to break bolts. The cable triggers the release at a much lower load on the pipework. MannTek recommends the SBC-C for that case.

faqs.question: What happens when it releases?
faqs.answer: The two halves separate and the valve in each half closes immediately, so neither the hose nor the fixed side is left open.

faqs.question: Which sizes are available?
faqs.answer: MannTek lists DN 50, DN 63, DN 80, DN 100 and DN 150 for the SBC-C. Ask if you need another size.

faqs.question: Which body materials are offered?
faqs.answer: Stainless steel 1.4408 (AISI 316) as standard, or aluminium, in every listed size.

products.descriptionLong:
The tank unit is the fixed half of a MannTek Dry Aviation Coupling (DAC). It has no swivel and is mounted as the filling connector on storage tanks, aviation refuellers and mobile tank containers. A DAC hose unit couples to it with a turning motion that opens the valves in both halves; turning back closes both before the halves separate, so aviation fuel is transferred with minimal product loss and no contamination from an open connection.

The DAC is built to ISO 45, MS24484 and STANAG 3105 with a 2-1/2" bayonet connection, and can be used at almost any transfer point in the fuel logistics chain: loading and unloading tank trucks and refuellers, de-fuelling and defence applications.

  • Working pressure: 10 bar; flow capacity up to 2,100 L/min (MannTek)
  • Threaded (BSP, NPT) or flanged (EN, ANSI, TW, TTMA) connections

Not for into-plane refuelling, and not approved for underwing refuelling.

Options

  • Dust caps and dust plugs in aluminium or PE (PE to -20 °C)
  • Adapters between DDC (STANAG 3756) and DAC (STANAG 3105), often used in military fuel handling
  • Drain connection, colour coding and special handles

products.seoDescription: MannTek DAC dry aviation coupling hose unit, ISO 45 / STANAG 3105, 2-1/2", aluminium, threaded or flanged, 10 bar. Authorised MannTek distributor, UAE.

faqs.question: Which connections can the hose unit have?
faqs.answer: Female BSP (1-1/2", 2-1/2", 3") or NPT (2-1/2", 3") threads, or flanges: DN 65 and DN 80 EN, ANSI Class 150, DIN 28459 TW 1, 3" and 4" TTMA, or undrilled Ø 210 mm. Special flanges are made to drawing.

faqs.question: Can the DAC be used for into-plane refuelling?
faqs.answer: No. MannTek states the DAC is not for into-plane refuelling and is not approved for underwing refuelling. It is for the fuel logistics chain: tank trucks, refuellers, storage, de-fuelling and defence use.

faqs.question: Which standards does the DAC meet?
faqs.answer: MannTek designs it to ISO 45, MS24484 and STANAG 3105, with a 2-1/2" bayonet connection.

faqs.question: Why does it matter that there are no yellow parts in contact with the fuel?
faqs.answer: Yellow metals such as brass and copper alloys are kept away from jet fuel. MannTek builds the DAC so that no yellow parts touch the medium.

faqs.question: What pressure is the DAC rated for?
faqs.answer: MannTek publishes 10 bar working pressure for the DAC.
